title: Grothendieck's existence theorem for closed subschemes of projective space over a complete Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] complete with respect to an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $X$ be a scheme over $A$ admitting, for some $n\ge0$, a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] $X\to\mathbf P^n_A$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$ into projective space $\mathbf P^n_A=\operatorname{Spec}A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Put $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X$. Then the completion functor $\mathit{Coh}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] is an equivalence of categories; in particular every object $(\mathcal F_n)$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ is isomorphic to $\mathcal F^\wedge$ for a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0885 (lemma-existence-projective), Section 087V (section-existence), for X -> Spec(A) H-projective, which is projective by Morphisms Lemma 01W9 (lemma-H-projective); its proof uses Lemmas 0883, 0884 (lemma-vanishing-projective), 087Y (lemma-inverse-systems-surjective), 087X, 0881 (lemma-exact)
